# AUTO-GENERATED by DI Updater Tool - district slot controls
DI_tm_slots_building_add = {
    scope = character
    is_valid = {
        any_in_list = { variable = DI_action_provinces has_holding = yes }
    }
    effect = {
        every_in_list = {
            variable = DI_action_provinces
            if = {
                limit = { has_holding = yes }
                while = {
                    limit = { has_province_modifier = DI_tm_slots_building_remove_modifier }
                    remove_province_modifier = DI_tm_slots_building_remove_modifier
                }
                add_province_modifier = DI_tm_slots_building_add_modifier
            }
        }
    }
}

DI_tm_slots_building_remove = {
    scope = character
    is_valid = {
        any_in_list = { variable = DI_action_provinces has_holding = yes }
    }
    effect = {
        every_in_list = {
            variable = DI_action_provinces
            if = {
                limit = { has_holding = yes }
                while = {
                    limit = { has_province_modifier = DI_tm_slots_building_remove_modifier }
                    remove_province_modifier = DI_tm_slots_building_remove_modifier
                }
                if = {
                    limit = { has_province_modifier = DI_tm_slots_building_add_modifier }
                    remove_province_modifier = DI_tm_slots_building_add_modifier
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = { has_province_modifier = add_building_slot }
                    remove_province_modifier = add_building_slot
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

DI_tm_slots_special_remove = {
    scope = character
    is_valid = {
        any_in_list = { variable = DI_action_provinces has_special_district_slot = yes }
    }
    effect = {
        every_in_list = {
            variable = DI_action_provinces
            if = {
                limit = { has_special_district_slot = yes }
                special_district ?= { remove_district = yes }
                if = {
                    limit = { has_special_district_slot = yes }
                    remove_special_district_slot = yes
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
